.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.- 2. Exemption is granted subject to all just legal exceptions. 1,3&4. This is an application under Section 526 Cr.P.C., for transfer of Sessions Case No.486/2022 from the Court of Additional Sessions Judge-IV/GBV, Khairpur, to any other Court.

The application is by the complainant of the case (Crime No.76/2022). The grounds taken for transfer in the application are completely vague. It is simply averred that the applicant/complainant has lost faith in the Presiding Judge. Confronted with that, learned counsel for applicant submits that the Presiding Officer has granted bail to the accused person who was already declared proclaimed offender, and that too on a previous surety submitted by him. While that ground has not been pleaded in the application, nevertheless the grant of bail to an accused person, even if he was declared proclaimed offender, does not ipso facto reflect any bias against the complainant.
In view of the foregoing, the transfer application is baseless, same is dismissed.
J U D G E Abdul Basit
